items.title: Choose the setup for D3’s Android update check
instructions: Choose USB/adb reverse on a PC, provide an HTTPS preview, or explicitly authorize two pre-release deployments to main.
The phone check becomes READY after D3 fixes, reviews, CI and final verification pass and the test address is prepared.
When the build is READY, follow docs/DEVICE_CHECKS.md under Updates and versions.
items.expected: The update offer appears within one minute without reinstalling, an unsaved edit survives the update, and the controls remain reachable.
